propositions: os.makedirs(ticket_dir, exist_ok=True) runs outside the write lock before the first event file is written, leaving an empty ticket directory stranded if the process is interrupted between directory creation and event publication
ticket directory and its CREATE event file must be published atomically so that fsck scanning cannot observe MISSING_CREATE or FOREIGN_STORE_PATH signatures for incomplete creates
staging directories use dot-prefixed naming convention (.tmp-newticket-*) to remain invisible to existing fsck scanners without requiring scanner modifications
batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, and dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT emission all share the same dir-then-file window and must be converted to use atomic staging and promotion

stale staging directories left by dead processes must be swept at writer startup using process ownership stamps (host + pid-namespace + start-time) without touching ticket directories or store data, respecting bug 043f
